summary: Stage 1: keep actual-state history bodies out of the SQLite sorter and stream the fold

replay.detail: Actual-state reads sort only canonical keys and integer claim identities, fetch each body on the same read cut, and fold it immediately. Existing canonical ordering, repaired-ID exclusion, historical cuts, field merging, indexes and admission/retention rules are unchanged. No new projection, source cap, migration or startup replay. Stage 1 of #2849(a): canonical key storage remains O(claims); every cache miss still reads/parses each history body. This does not implement an incremental actual-state projection or close the issue.
